editorial:
Imagine you are walking through the gritty streets of 1970s Stockholm when a family tragedy turns into a nightmare. You follow a guy and his best friend who are desperate to find the dealer that sold drugs to the girl who just died. It starts as a mystery but quickly turns into a wild chase. You will meet Harry, a smooth but totally evil crime boss who doesn't play around. The movie has a very raw, mean spirit and doesn't shy away from the dark side of the city, including some really shocking scenes in brothels and some very cruel violence that will leave you stunned.

What really sticks with you is how fast the action moves and the sheer brutality of the villains. The acting is solid, though the plot can get a bit messy. If you like old-school crime movies that feel dangerous and unpredictable, you will love this. It is definitely not for the faint of heart, but it is a ride.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a brutal showdown. After Harry kills his own man, Servus, using a scary razor blade glove for failing him, the tension reaches a breaking point. The heroes finally face off against Harry and his thugs. In a violent clash, the bad guys get what they deserve. The cycle of revenge closes as the drug ring is torn down, leaving the survivors to deal with the trauma of what they saw and did.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves raw 70s crime thrillers and shocking twists.
